text:
triage-bot: ALERT: sustained spike in 5xx on /v1/generate (prod-us-east-1). Detected at 2026-03-15T18:12:23Z. Paging #eng-oncall (incident INC-2409).

triage-bot: Summary: 5xx rate ~12% over last 10m, increased p50 latency, heap growth on some runtimes. Affected route: /v1/generate, streaming endpoints primarily. Error sample: "kv cache miss -> model runner OOM".

leah: i'm primary, grabbing this. starting quick blast radius check — @omar you on secondary?

omar: on secondary, be there in 30s. good first step: throttle non-prod and reduce batch size for streaming.

kevin: noticed a weird pattern — errors spike correlated with long-context requests (>8k). possible kv-cache thrash. runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving/5xx-routing (see "kv cache thrash" section).

leah: running quick mitigation: scale down batch sizes and pin to non-prefetch path. going to apply small routing tweak to send streaming requests to fallback model-variant (v2-small-quant) while we stabilize.

leah: ops-bot: executing change: set route /v1/generate.streaming -> model=v2-small-quant for prod-us-east-1 (canary 10% -> 100% if ok).

ops-bot: change queued. Applying canary to 10% now.

juniper: logs from runner-7 show repeated allocations then eviction:

```
2026-03-15T18:11:58Z runner-7 [warn] kvcache insert failed: reserve failed: out of memory
2026-03-15T18:12:02Z runner-7 [error] decode loop: rpc failed: stream closed
```

leah: ok that supports kv OOM. plan: 1) keep canary on 10% for 3m, 2) reduce global streaming batch from 64->16, 3) spin up 2 extra runner pods with higher mem flavor. doing steps 2+3 now.

maria: FYI — customer impact lookup: hosted customers with streaming on US-EAST show increased 502 and truncated streams ~18:10Z - 18:20Z. CS flagged 3 paying customers; estimated impact window ~10m. tagging account manager.

kevin: file a post-incident support ticket ASAP with impact summary and RCA stub. ticket: OPS-4123 (created). link: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/OPS-4123

leah: ran the scale command:

```
kubectl -n redwood scale deploy/runner --replicas=22 --selector=pool=streaming-us
redwoodctl config set /routes/generate.streaming model_variant=v2-small-quant --canary=10%
```

leah: batch config change applied: `runtime-config set streaming.batch_size 16`

ops-bot: canary metrics: error rate for canary down to 1.5% after 90s, p95 latency improved. rolling to 100% now.

omar: can we flush prefix cache on affected pods to avoid stale kv state? runbook recommends `redwoodctl cache flush --pool streaming-us`

leah: doing that: `redwoodctl cache flush --pool streaming-us --confirm`

juniper: after flush, runner-7 mem usage dropped and error loops stopped. p50/p95 back to normal for canary traffic.

kevin: good. confirm there are no degraded regions now?

maria: US-EAST still had minor blips for non-canary customers but stable after canary rolled. EU unaffected.

leah: quick status: incident INC-2409 — mitigated (routing to smaller variant + batch reduction + cache flush). customer impact: three hosted customers experienced truncated streaming responses ~10m window; support ticket OPS-4123 opened; outreach in progress.

maria: i'll own follow-up outreach + support notes. putting a brief message to #customer-success with incident summary and next steps.

leah: reminder for handoff: my shift ends in ~18m. i will stay as primary until handoff unless anything urgent pops. @maria you'll be the next primary, @omar will stay secondary for overlap. Confirm?

omar: confirmed. i'll remain on standby for the next 30m to help with postmortem data pull.

maria: confirmed, i'll take primary at 18:30Z.

kevin: immediate action items (short):
- A1: write timeline & attach logs to OPS-4123 (owner: kevin)
- A2: confirm customer outreach & share templates (owner: maria)
- A3: add a short eval to Redwood Optimize to track regression for long-context streaming (owner: leah)
- A4: check runner provisioning quotas across us-east cluster (owner: omar)

leah: filing internal follow-ups now. created infra task INFRA-889 (increase runner burst limit) and QA task QA-1422 (add long-context streaming test). Links in OPS-4123.

ops-bot: Reminder: schedule retro within 72h. Quick poll: preferred slot Thu 2026-03-17 16:00 UTC or Fri 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC.

maria: Thu 16:00 UTC works for me.

omar: Thu works.

leah: leaving a handoff note for Maria: `/hand-off note: mitigations applied = routing->v2-small-quant, batch_size=16, cache_flush; tickets = OPS-4123, INFRA-889, QA-1422; next steps = timeline + eval + quota bump follow-up`

maria: thanks — i'll run through the checklist and update OPS-4123 with outreach status in the next hour. tagging @kevin for timeline add.

kevin: will attach logs and a short timeline by 19:00Z.

leah: ok handing off primary to @maria at 18:30Z. i'll be available by DM for 15m after handoff.

maria: i am primary now (18:30Z). taking responsibility for OPS-4123 and the retro scheduling.

juniper: small note: consider adding a circuit-breaker for long-context streaming clients to avoid saturating kv cache — raised as a design item in INFRA-889.

maria: adding that to retro agenda. thanks everyone. closing thread for active mitigation; will update when outreach and RCA draft are ready. :white_check_mark:
